November 18, 2013

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.

ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
November 18, 2013

1.  OPENING CEREMONIES

a.  Call Meeting to Order

A regular meeting of the Lomita City Council was called to order at 7:00 p.m., on
Monday, November 18, 2013, in the Council Chambers, at Lomita City Hall, 24300
Narbonne Avenue.

b.  Flag Salute

Christina Roehm led the salute to the flag.

c.  Invocation

Councilmember Sanchez gave the invocation.

d.  Roll Call

Those responding to roll call by Assistant City Clerk Shumway were
COUNCILMEMBERS: Gazeley, Traina, Savidan, Sanchez, and Mayor Estrada. Also
present were City Manager Rock, Assistant City Manager Sugano, City Attorney Hogin,
Community Services Director McPherron, Parks and Recreation Director Harding,
Public Works Director Damasse, Administrative Services Director Chavez, and Assistant
City Clerk Shumway.

2.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

Councilmember Gazeley moved to approve the agenda.  Councilmember Sanchez
seconded the motion, which carried unanimously.

3.  PRESENTATIONS

Mayor Estrada recognized Chris Dunn for winning first place in the Giant Pumpkin
Weigh-Off and Contest at the 2013 Pumpkinmania, which took place at Tanaka Farms
in Irvine, CA. Since Mr. Dunn was not able to attend the meeting, Mayor Estrada stated
that a certificate of recognition will be mailed to him.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  Page 1
 Scott Gobble, Representative of the Lomita Chamber of Commerce, invited those in
attendance to the Chamber’s next Business Networking Mixer, which will take place at
Massey’s House of Flowers on Thursday, November 21, 2013, from 5:30 p.m. to 7:30
p.m.

Helen Everett, employee of the City of Lomita’s Parks and Recreation Department,
presented Mayor Estrada with a bouquet of flowers and thanked her on behalf of the
Lomita City Employees Association for her support of City employees over the years.

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE
  CITY COUNCIL

There were no oral communications or reports from the City Council.

6. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

City Manager Rock provided an update regarding the Eshelman Avenue Waterline and
Resurfacing Project, and announced that the street will be paved and that most of the
residents on Eshelman Avenue will be connected to the new water line by early
December 2013. City Manager Rock also reported that the Cypress Water Production
Facility is operating well.

7. CONSENT AGENDA

Councilmember Traina and Mayor Estrada recused themselves from voting on Item 7.E,
due to conflicts of interest. Councilmember Gazeley moved to approve the Consent
Agenda. Councilmember Savidan seconded the motion, which carried unanimously.

  a. Motion to Waive Further Reading

  b. Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Regular City Council Meeting
  held on November 4, 2013. RECOMMEND APPROVAL

  c. Approval of Demands

  d. Approval of Amendment No 1. to an existing Lease Agreement with New Cingular
  Wireless PCS, LLC (AT&T Mobility Corporation) regarding the Wireless
  Communication Facility Site at Lomita City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
  RECOMMEND APPROVAL

  e. Approval of a Settlement Agreement and Release with Tetra Tech, Inc., relative to
  the Cypress Water Production Facility, in which Tetra Tech will provide preliminary

  Page 2
   review, design services, project management, and $20,000 toward certain repairs,
  retrofits, and upgrades of the facility. RECOMMEND APPROVAL

  SCHEDULED MATTERS

8.  RATIFY THE RESULTS OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION OF
  NOVEMBER 5, 2013

City Manager/City Clerk Rock announced that a total of 2,020 ballots were cast in the
election, from a registered voter pool of 11,337, which was a 17.8% turnout. City
Manager Rock went on to state that James Gazeley, Ben Traina, and Mark Waronek
had been elected to the City Council by virtue of receiving the most votes. Lastly, City
Manager Rock recommended that a resolution ratifying the results of the General
Municipal Election of November 5, 2013, be approved.

Councilmember Savidan moved to approve staff’s recommendation. Councilmember
Sanchez seconded the motion, which carried unanimously.

9.  OATH OF OFFICE AND ISSUANCE OF CERTIFICATE OF ELECTION

City Manager/City Clerk Rock administered the Oath of Office to the newly-elected City
officials (James Gazeley, Ben Traina, and Mark Waronek), and presented each of them
with a certificate of election.

10. SEATING OF NEWLY ELECTED CITY OFFICIALS

The newly-elected City officials were seated.

11. INTRODUCTIONS AND COMMENTS BY NEWLY ELECTED OFFICIALS

This item was heard after item #12.

Councilmember Ben Traina thanked the City’s election workers for their hard work on
Election Day, the voters for their support, and his family, especially his son Ryan, who
served as his campaign manager.

Councilmember Mark Waronek thanked his family and friends for their support, and the
voters for bringing him back as a Councilmember. Furthermore, Councilmember
Waronek thanked Councilmember Gazeley for guiding and helping him with his
campaign, and for being a true friend.

  Page 3
 Councilmember Gazeley thanked his family and friends for their support, and the voters
for trusting him again.

Councilmember Sanchez stated that he was grateful to voters for electing good men to
serve the City of Lomita, and added that he was looking forward to working with them.

Mayor Savidan thanked the City Council for selecting him to serve as Mayor, and stated
that he was honored to represent the City of Lomita. Furthermore, Mayor Savidan
thanked staff for their hard work, and stated that there were a number of challenges to
work through during the next year, including street repairs; the helicopter noise issue;
the upcoming budget; and street parking and traffic issues. Lastly, Mayor Savidan
thanked his family for all their support.

12. SELECTION OF MAYOR AND MAYOR PRO TEM

City Manager/City Clerk Rock opened the nominations for Mayor. Councilmember
Gazeley nominated Councilmember and Mayor Pro Tem Savidan to serve a Mayor.
Councilmember Sanchez seconded nomination. There being no other nominations for
Mayor, Councilmember Savidan was declared Mayor for 2013/14, by unanimous vote.

Mayor Savidan opened the nominations for the Mayor Pro Tem. Councilmember
Gazeley nominated Councilmember Sanchez. Councilmember Traina seconded the
nomination. There being no other nominations for Mayor Pro Tem, Councilmember
Sanchez was declared Mayor Pro Tem for 2013/14, by unanimous vote.

13. PRESENTATIONS TO OUTGOING MAYOR MARGARET ESTRADA

a. Proclamation from the City Council to Margaret Estrada for her years of service to
  the City.

  Mayor Savidan presented a plaque to outgoing Mayor Estrada, and read a
  proclamation recognizing Mayor Estrada’s 35 years of service to the City of Lomita
  and her outstanding performance as both a Councilmember and Mayor.

b. Presentation from Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors Don Knabe’s Office to
  Mayor Estrada for her years of public service.

  Steve Napolitano, Representative of Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors Don
  Knabe’s Office, thanked Mayor Estrada for being a very effective representative of
  the City of Lomita, for doing so much for the residents, and for being a tireless
  advocate for the community.

  Page 4
   Steve Yanko, President of the Lomita Historic Society, presented a resolution from
  the Society to Mayor Estrada, recognizing her years of service and for all the
  assistance she provided to the Society.

  Captain Bolin, from the Lomita Sheriff’s Station, presented a certificate of
  recognition, on behalf of Los Angeles County Sheriff Leroy Baca and all Sheriff’s
  Station personnel, to Mayor Estrada for her distinguished service. Furthermore,
  Captain Bolin personally congratulated Mayor Estrada on this occasion and wished
  her all the best in her future endeavors.

  City Manager Rock thanked Mayor Estrada for her 35 years of public service, and on
  a personal note, for helping him as the City’s new City Manager. Lastly, on behalf of
  all City employees, City Manager Rock thanked Mayor Estrada for being a strong
  supporter of staff over the years.

ADJOURNMENT

Meeting adjourned in memory of Gloria Phillips and Bill Sharman at 7:44 p.m.

Respectfully Submitted,

__________________________________
Lena Shumway, Assistant City Clerk, CMC

  Page 5
